name: Spark Savings USDT
oneLiner: spUSDT is Spark's yield-bearing USDT wrapper for Spark Liquidity Layer allocations, accruing protocol-set returns from SLL deployment routes.

sources.label: Spark Savings V2 backing and risk architecture (accessed 2026-09-30)

dependencyReview.rationale: Spark identifies spUSDT and spUSDC as V2 vaults fully backed by USDS, separately from legacy sUSDC V1. The documented waterfall starts with Prime-internal and Prime-external junior capital at equal preference, followed by external senior srUSDS capital (described as planned), the Sky Surplus Buffer, the Aggregate Surplus Buffer and SKY-token recapitalization. Only after the available capital and token backstops are exhausted are residual losses socialized equally across USDS holders, including Spark Savings stablecoin vaults. The USDS mechanism claim and native USDT wrapper parent are serial constraints combined by the worse parent, not additive portfolio weights or an immediate loss coefficient.

relationships.reason: Issuer-documented full USDS backing and residual loss socialization after the junior/senior capital and token-backstop waterfall; no current USDS custody percentage is inferred.
The V2 USDT vault remains a USDT-denominated ERC-4626 claim; the structural native-asset parent is retained alongside USDS backing.

collateral: USDT deposited into Spark Savings Vault V2 (ERC-4626 asset=USDT); idle USDT is taken by the Spark Liquidity Layer into SparkLend, Morpho, and other supported yield strategies, with Spark docs framing V2 USD vaults as economically backed by USDS / Sky balance-sheet liquidity for redemptions.
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDT into Spark Savings Vault V2 and receive spUSDT; a permissioned Spark Liquidity Layer taker deploys idle USDT into yield strategies while share value accrues via the vault savings rate (vsr), not the Sky Savings Rate or legacy sUSDC path.
